examples.zh: 这张老照片对我很珍贵。
examples.en: This old photo is very precious to me.

examples.zh: 时间是最珍贵的东西。
examples.en: Time is the most precious thing.

examples.zh: 这是一份珍贵的礼物。
examples.en: This is a precious gift.

note: 思维 方式 = way of thinking; 思维 is the thinking process, 想法 is a specific idea.

examples.zh: 他的思维方式很特别。
examples.en: His way of thinking is very unusual.

examples.zh: 孩子的思维很快。
examples.en: Children's thinking is very quick.

examples.zh: 我们要换一种思维来想这个问题。
examples.en: We should think about this problem in a different way.

meaning: to compensate for; to lose money

senses.en: to compensate for; to lose money

note: Two uses: 赔 钱 (pay up) and 赔 了 钱 (lose money in business).

examples.zh: 你丢了我的书，要赔我。
examples.en: You lost my book, so you have to pay me back.

examples.zh: 这家店去年赔了很多钱。
examples.en: This shop lost a lot of money last year.

examples.zh: 我不小心打破了杯子，我赔吧。
examples.en: I accidentally broke the cup. Let me pay for it.

examples.zh: 我女儿要参加英语竞赛。
examples.en: My daughter is going to enter an English contest.

examples.zh: 这次竞赛有一百多人参加。
examples.en: More than a hundred people joined this contest.

examples.zh: 学校每年都办一次竞赛。
examples.en: The school holds a contest once a year.

meaning: letter received; to write in to us

senses.en: letter received; to write in to us

note: Used for a letter you receive: 读者来信; 收到你的来信.

examples.zh: 我收到了你的来信，谢谢。
examples.en: I received your letter, thank you.

examples.zh: 报纸每天收到很多读者来信。
examples.en: The newspaper gets many readers' letters every day.

examples.zh: 请尽快回复他的来信。
examples.en: Please reply to his letter as soon as possible.

note: A weighty word: 追求真理 (pursue truth). Everyday "true" is 真的.

examples.zh: 科学家一直在找真理。
examples.en: Scientists keep searching for truth.

examples.zh: 有时候，真理在少数人手里。
examples.en: Sometimes the truth is in the hands of a few.

examples.zh: 我们要用事实说明真理。
examples.en: We should use facts to show the truth.

examples.zh: 他正在读博士学位。
examples.en: He is working on a doctoral degree.

examples.zh: 她在国外拿到了硕士学位。
examples.en: She got a master's degree abroad.

examples.zh: 这份工作需要学位吗？
examples.en: Does this job require a degree?

note: Literary: 人间 天堂 = paradise on earth; 人间 烟火 = everyday human life.

examples.zh: 这样的好人在人间很少见。
examples.en: Good people like this are rare in the world.

examples.zh: 他的朋友已经离开了人间。
examples.en: His friend has already passed away.

examples.zh: 爱情是人间最美的事。
examples.en: Love is the most beautiful thing in the human world.

note: Written/neutral word; in everyday speech people also say 青菜 or just 菜.

examples.zh: 医生说我应该多吃蔬菜。
examples.en: The doctor said I should eat more vegetables.

examples.zh: 这家超市的蔬菜很新鲜。
examples.en: The vegetables at this supermarket are very fresh.

examples.zh: 你喜欢吃什么蔬菜？
examples.en: What vegetables do you like to eat?

examples.zh: 这座老桥已经修复好了。
examples.en: This old bridge has been restored.

examples.zh: 电脑里的文件还能修复吗？
examples.en: Can the files on the computer still be repaired?

examples.zh: 他们的关系很难修复了。
examples.en: Their relationship is hard to repair now.

note: Written style; spoken: 这个时候.

examples.zh: 此时，他才发现自己错了。
examples.en: Only at that moment did he realize he was wrong.

examples.zh: 此时此刻，我最想回家。
examples.en: At this very moment, what I want most is to go home.

examples.zh: 此时外面正下着大雨。
examples.en: It was pouring outside at that time.

meaning: to firmly believe; to determine (a fact)

senses.en: to firmly believe; to determine (a fact)

note: 认定 + clause = be convinced that...; 被认定 = be determined (officially) to be.

examples.zh: 他认定这件事是你做的。
examples.en: He is convinced that you did it.

examples.zh: 医生认定这是一种过敏。
examples.en: The doctor determined that this is an allergy.

examples.zh: 别认定自己一定会失败。
examples.en: Don't be so sure you will fail.

examples.zh: 这家饭店的服务是一流的。
examples.en: The service at this restaurant is first-class.

examples.zh: 他想去一所一流大学读书。
examples.en: He wants to study at a top university.

examples.zh: 她的中文水平是一流的。
examples.en: Her Chinese is top-notch.

note: Often of arguments, evidence or speech: 有力 的 证据.

examples.zh: 这是一个很有力的证据。
examples.en: This is very strong evidence.

examples.zh: 他的回答听起来很有力。
examples.en: His answer sounded very forceful.

examples.zh: 这位老人走路很有力。
examples.en: This old man walks with vigor.

examples.zh: 我们应该珍惜在一起的时间。
examples.en: We should cherish the time we spend together.

examples.zh: 你要珍惜这次机会。
examples.en: You should treasure this opportunity.

examples.zh: 我很珍惜这份友谊。
examples.en: I really cherish this friendship.

examples.zh: 这口锅太重了，我拿不动。
examples.en: This pot is too heavy; I can't lift it.

examples.zh: 请把菜倒进锅里。
examples.en: Please pour the vegetables into the wok.

examples.zh: 锅里的汤还热着。
examples.en: The soup in the pot is still hot.

meaning: to realize, discover (something not noticed before)

senses.en: to realize, discover (something not noticed before)

examples.zh: 到了门口，我才发觉忘带手机了。
examples.en: At the door I realized I had forgotten my phone.

examples.zh: 他发觉她好像不高兴。
examples.en: He noticed she seemed unhappy.

examples.zh: 你有没有发觉他最近变了？
examples.en: Have you noticed he's changed recently?

note: 食物 中毒 = food poisoning.

examples.zh: 他吃坏了东西，中毒了。
examples.en: He ate something bad and got food poisoning.

examples.zh: 孩子中毒了，快去医院！
examples.en: The child has been poisoned; get to the hospital quickly!

examples.zh: 房间里煤气太多，容易中毒。
examples.en: Too much gas in the room can easily cause poisoning.

note: Bound form: 旅行社, 出版社, 社会, 社区.

examples.zh: 我在旅行社订了机票。
examples.en: I booked the flight ticket at a travel agency.

examples.zh: 他在出版社工作。
examples.en: He works at a publishing house.

examples.zh: 这家报社在北京。
examples.en: This newspaper office is in Beijing.

meaning: to wait for (more formal than 等)

senses.en: to wait for (more formal than 等)

note: 等候 is formal/polite (notices, service); casual speech uses 等.

examples.zh: 请在门口等候，医生马上来。
examples.en: Please wait at the door; the doctor will be right here.

examples.zh: 他在车站等候了一个小时。
examples.en: He waited at the station for an hour.

examples.zh: 我们正在等候你的回信。
examples.en: We are waiting for your reply.
